name: Xiaofang Yuan Connor
source:
The game tells a story in a modern world where humans and furries coexist. The player will play the role of Luo Geng, who is 22 year-old, eligible for marriage registration, and somehow ends up with a marriage with a furry firefighter named Connor.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2384920/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
游戏讲述了人类和兽类共存的现代世界的故事。玩家将扮演罗庚，22岁，符合结婚登记条件，最终与毛茸茸的消防员康纳结婚。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2384920/]Steam[/url]]
